Scene:
古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物，常常一吃就死。但是不知道为什么，没有办法。所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物，告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物：古代的时候，人们
- 所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
- 告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险：是安全的，是危险的
- 发现有的植物对身体非常好，特别是茶，让肚子感觉又暖和又清楚：add他in the beginning; delete 感觉，又暖和又舒服

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Temporality): 告诉：告诉了，this is the last action in a completed series of actions, so it takes “了”; earlier verbs in the series do not need it. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
Run 2: Coherence (Temporality): 告诉：告诉了，The testing and telling are completed narrative actions; in a series of actions, the last verb takes 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
Run 3: 告诉人：告诉人们，this refers to the group of people in the story, so 人们 is needed. [teacher rule: ren_renmen]

output.reason: Runs 1 and 2 change 告诉 to 告诉了 for completed aspect, while Run 3 changes 人 to 人们, so they target different issues.
